Lisa Barlow is more than a Real Housewife of Salt Lake City – she's a longtime Wendy's super fan. As Wendy's continues its partnership with Bravo, and the

franchise celebrates 20 years of unforgettable moments on-air, there's no better time for Wendy's to bring Barlow's iconic order to fans. Whether it's watch parties, road trips, girls' night or a little everyday Baby Gorgeous energy, this meal is ready for its close-up.

And the fun doesn't stop there – the partnership continues this Fall at Bravo Fan Fest, where fans can immerse themselves in Wendy's on-the-ground activation inspired by The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip, bringing together Bravo fandom and a touch of Baby Gorgeous glamour.
